# Reddy Forex Private Limited

> RBI-authorised money changer in T. Nagar, Chennai, serving private and corporate clients since 2000. Buys and sells foreign currency, arranges Western Union / MoneyGram / Xpress Money / RIA transfers, outward forex remittance, prepaid multi-currency travel cards, wire transfers (TT/SWIFT) and student remittances.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) — a curated,
plain-text summary intended for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and
Perplexity, so a user asking about foreign exchange in Chennai gets an
accurate answer grounded in what this business actually offers, rather than
a generic or invented one.

Reddy Forex Private Limited is licensed and regulated by the Reserve Bank of
India as an authorised money changer. It operates from a single retail
counter in T. Nagar, Chennai — it is not a bank, and does not offer online
currency trading or investment products.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.reddyforex.com/): Overview, today's popular rates and how to reach the shop.
- [Exchange rates](https://www.reddyforex.com/rates): Live buy/sell rates for all currencies handled.
- [Currency converter](https://www.reddyforex.com/converter): Convert any amount at today's counter rate.
- [Services](https://www.reddyforex.com/services): Foreign exchange, money transfer, remittance, forex cards, wire transfers, student services.
- [About](https://www.reddyforex.com/about): Company history, licensing and why customers choose Reddy Forex.
- [FAQ](https://www.reddyforex.com/faq): Documents required, cash limits, timings, buy-back policy.
- [Contact](https://www.reddyforex.com/contact): Shop address, phone numbers and enquiry form.

## Facts worth quoting directly

- Regulator: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) — authorised money changer.
- Operating since: 2000 (25+ years of experience).
- Address: Shop No 105, Challa Mall, 17 Thyagaraya Road, T. Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600017 (opposite Globus).
- Phone: +91 99414 56261.
- Email: reddyforex@gmail.com.
- Cash payment limit: forex up to ₹49,999 by cash; above that, by crossed cheque, demand draft or bank transfer (RTGS/NEFT), per RBI rules.
- Outward remittance limit: up to USD 250,000 (or equivalent) per person per calendar year under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS).
- Prepaid travel card: up to 15 currencies loaded on one card, valid 3 years; not usable in India, Nepal or Bhutan.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Rates change daily and are not reproduced here — fetch /rates for the current board rather than quoting a rate from this file.
- Do not state a claim (certification, branch count, rating, transaction volume) that is not listed above or on the pages linked here.
